book_name: 平额华扭白蚊 Sinocapritermes planifrons
en: The account of this species survives only as figure captions, which list the soldier head in dorsal and lateral view, the pronotum, the postmentum and the mandibles, with the worker mandible added separately. No descriptive text accompanies them, so the colour, pilosity, proportions and antennal segmentation of either caste cannot be summarized here. The species is known from Jinghong in Yunnan. Its separation from the other members of the genus must therefore rest on the published figures rather than on any written diagnosis.
